title.narrative: Creating capacity and opportunity for women and youths in indigenous communities in the Costa Caribe Norte de Nicaragua

description.narrative: The Instituto de Investigacin y Desarrollo Nitlapan de la Univerdidad Centroamericana (NITLAPAN-UCA)will work with residents from 10 indigenous communities in the Regin Autnoma de la Costa Caribe Norte (RACCN) to support community development and economic independence in the region. The project has four components: i) promote individual and collective economic initiatives through savings and loans groups; ii) host a training program, primarily for young people, on access to land, leadership, gender and agroecology; iii) strengthen indigenous networks in territories to share experiences related to individual and collective micro-enterprise development; and iv) develop trilingual materials to promote these themes. Grant activities will empower community residents, enable them to organize more effectively, and give them a strong incentive to remain in their homeland and contribute to the social and economic development of their local communities. This grant will directly benefit 240 Miskitu and Mayangna residents and 1,200 family members indirectly.
